facts.name: UGameEngine::Tick(float DeltaSeconds, bool bIdleMode)
facts.note: The engine's per-frame tick (world ticks, then the viewport-client tick, then RedrawViewports in both builds). Named in both dbs; the live engine is a plain UGameEngine (object dumps), and the UEndGameEngine override is a thunk that jumps here. Entry bytes identical in both builds; the first instruction (5 bytes) sits inside one 16-byte block in both (1.004 entry mod 16 = 0, 1.005 = 8), no branch lands inside. src/engine_tick.cpp.

facts.name: vtbl_UGameEngine's Tick entry (UE4SS UEngine slot 10 after the UObject virtuals: whole slot 87 in 1.004, 88 in 1.005)
facts.note: vtbl_UGameEngine 0x146B9A470 (1.004) / 0x1469FEA78 (1.005); the slot holds UGameEngine::Tick in both. Read live by engine_tick::Install to confirm the function is the one the vtable dispatches to.
